_help: Shop upgrades. 'costs' has one price per level, so its length is the max level. 'perLevel' is what each level adds: lives (extra lives per game), respins (re-spins per hub visit), consolation (extra tokens on any failed run). An upgrade with no perLevel can still be checked by name, like bigger-bets in economy.json.

upgrades.name: Re-spin
description: Don't like what landed? Spin again,
once per trip to the hub.

description: +3 tokens on every run you lose.
